title: 7 SMS Marketing Tools Accounting Firms Use in 2026

facts.fact: The page attributes a tax-prep peak utilization figure of 85-95% to Thomson Reuters (2025).
Twilio's published US SMS entry price is $0.0083 per segment, as checked by the page in August 2026.
TextMagic's published US SMS prepaid price is $0.049 per message, as checked by the page in August 2026.
SimpleTexting's published entry price is $29 to $39 for 500 credits, as checked by the page in August 2026.
EZ Texting's Launch plan is listed at $25 per month, or $20 per month on annual billing, as checked in August 2026.
SlickText's published entry price is $29 for 500 credits, as checked in August 2026.
Textedly's published entry price is $29 for 500 messages, as checked in August 2026.
ClickSend's Boost tier is listed at about $0.029 per SMS, as checked in August 2026.
Twilio's long code number is listed at $1.15 per month.
TextMagic charges $10 per month for its 10DLC campaign on top of its self-serve 10DLC path.
SimpleTexting lists an extra local number at $10 per month.
SimpleTexting charges $20 per month for extra users after the first three.
The page's planning model puts SimpleTexting's 12-month total at about $1,188 to $1,320 for 2,000 SMS per month.
EZ Texting's Boost plan is listed at $75 per month and its Scale plan at $125 per month.
SlickText's 2,000-credit tier is listed at $79 for the planning model.
The page's planning model puts Twilio's 12-month total at about $330 to $420 for 2,000 SMS per month.
The page's planning model puts TextMagic's 12-month total at about $1,416 for 2,000 SMS per month.
The page's planning model puts ClickSend's 12-month total at about $700 to $900 for 2,000 SMS per month.
Twilio's outbound MMS is listed at $0.022.
The page states that its listed prices are vendor-published starting rates as of August 2026, and that carrier surcharges, TCR brand fees, and overages sit on top.
facts.quote: List prices are vendor-published starting rates as of August 2026.

facts.fact: The page states that public pricing pages and developer docs were read in August 2026, and that no live tax-season send was run.
facts.quote: Public pricing pages and developer docs were read in August 2026.

facts.fact: The page weights consent, STOP, and 10DLC workflow at 25% in its evaluation scoring.
The page weights credit and number economics at 2,000 SMS per month at 20% in its evaluation scoring.
facts.quote: Credit and number economics at 2,000 SMS/mo | 20%

facts.fact: The article is dated August 31, 2026.
